definition: School counseling is the support provided in schools by counselors to help students with academic, emotional, social, behavioral, and relationship-related difficulties. It can also include services for families and teachers to support students’ wellbeing and adjustment at school.

reasons: “Students’ wellbeing and adjustment at school” is not stated in the packet and goes beyond the described school-counseling services.
The definition adds a generalized purpose (“support ... wellbeing and adjustment”) that is not directly supported by the source text.
The packet does not explicitly define school counseling as “support provided in schools by counselors”; it only discusses “services offered by school counselors” in the context of COVID-19.

The definition’s framing that counselors “help students with” academic, emotional, social, behavioral, and relationship-related difficulties is not stated as a definition/purpose in the packet; the packet reports that students’ difficulties included academic/social/emotional/behavioral and relational themes, but does not directly characterize school counseling as providing help for those categories.

The definition’s inclusion of services for “teachers” is only mentioned as a category of services offered (“services for the teacher”) without establishing it as part of a general definitional description of school counseling.
